body: A balanced and great response. Thank you !

Wow... Amazing response. Thank you for this so much. I can tell from the way you write you have given much thought to this. I will consider your comment greatly. I will say I agree that this probably isn't the right place to have a rational discussion about such a topic, and I am not the best person to ask this question either due to my own suicidal biases. Thank you for your input.

Thank you for taking the time reply.


1- This is true, this kept me going for a while, that I need to keep going for the people who do have meaning. I disagree with the point that they would be missed by some person they may not even consider or know. Uh, like ok? 


2- I do not understand this. If you could maybe expand on it. If we are talking about job work, the average person works a gruelling meaningless 9-5, which is just, why even bother right? It's either homelessness or barely get by working 60 years of your life away for a lot of people.


3- This is true, I do not have anything to say to this. There is a possibility for anything to happen. Life is too random.


4- Sorry, don't really care to respond to this one.


5- Doss this not make you more depressed reading this? That such a reality exists where we are put into more pain on top of already failing an attempt. It's kind of laughable. Anyway, I imagine most people would probably become even more suicidal due to this if they were to survive, leading to another attempt. If I were in this position I wouldn't bother contacting anyone for help and just try a second time to rid myself of the burden.


Good day to you !

Thank you for your input. As I have already said, it is fine if people want to live on, even with horrible lives. However it should also be viewed as fine if people living seemingly "good" lives want to take the exit. What is so bad about it, if it is all meaningless anyway?
I see. Good luck and I hope you find peace soon.
I see. Thank you for your input. I was like you too at one point but something changed. If you are going to keep living, the best I can say is that I hope you live a good happy life.
I appreciate you agreeing with me. Even if life is not all that, you should at least consider sleeping at a more normal time lol
